meta.name: Inside The Rage Machine
meta.description: Inside The Rage Machinehighlights new whistleblowers, engineers, and managers from inside tech corporations to show how algorithms that spread disinformation, social harms, and contribute to violence erupting in the real world are knowingly deployed by the companies to have these harms and incentives built-in. Through the lived experience and documents obtained from employees such as Matt Motyl from Facebook, Ruofan Ding from TikTok, and Lisa Jennings Young from Twitter,Inside The Rage Machineexposes the system itself that thrives on outrage and division as part of its business model, with radicalisation, real-world violence and fractured societies as just some of the consequences of the system that has been built to manipulate how users think, feel and perceive the world.
